summary: Iteration 33 — Google/Facebook social sign-in + Map Legend + docked-card quick-actions verified. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass (POST /api/auth/google-session returns 401 for invalid session_id, 422 for missing/short session_id, endpoint registered in OpenAPI, /api/auth/login demo login still 200, /api/auth/apple + /api/register-push routed, /api/auth/me still 401 without bearer). Frontend: /login and /register both render google-signin + facebook-signin testIDs in the same order; apple-signin correctly hidden on web (iOS-only). Google button click navigates to https://auth.emergentagent.com → Google accounts (real Emergent OAuth handshake). Facebook button click causes NO navigation (coming-soon stub). Signed-in map (/) renders map-legend-chip bottom-left, all 8 filter chips (For Sale, For Rent, Land, Commercial, Luxury, Verified, Recently Added, Open House), and legend modal shows all 8 property-type colours (Residential, Apartment, Estate, Land, Commercial, Industrial, Hospitality, Institutional) + Verified badge + Hot listing with separate icons. Docked-card quick-actions (docked-save/-view/-contact) COULD NOT be exercised via web preview because the web map is a static image with a 'Interactive map available on mobile' hint — this is by existing design and NOT a regression. Code review of MapDockedCard.tsx confirms all three testIDs are wired and onContact hook calls api.chatStartFromProperty per spec.

integration_issues.issue: React-Native-Web's Alert.alert falls back to window.alert which was not captured by Playwright's dialog listener in one run. Behaviourally the button does not navigate and does not crash — matches the 'no navigation occurred' acceptance criterion. If crisper web UX is desired, consider a custom in-page modal (or Platform.OS==='web' ? window.confirm : Alert.alert). NOT blocking.

Web preview renders the map as a static image ('Interactive map available on mobile'), so marker clicks do not open the docked card and testIDs docked-save-<id>/docked-view-<id>/docked-contact-<id> could not be exercised via web automation. Code review of MapDockedCard.tsx confirms all three testIDs and onContact wiring are correct. Retest on native/Expo Go build recommended for full confirmation.

action_items: Optional polish: Facebook 'coming soon' Alert doesn't render a visible dialog on RN-Web (Alert.alert is a no-op on web in some RN versions). Consider showing a small in-page toast/modal for web parity — not blocking, current behaviour (no navigation) is acceptable.
Docked-card quick-actions (docked-save/view/contact) should be re-verified on Expo Go / native build since web preview map is static.
All backend + login/register/map-legend/filter-chip acceptance criteria met; no fixes required.
critical_code_review_comments: google_auth.py cleanly upserts-by-email so pre-existing password accounts get linked (google_linked=true) with no duplicate — matches the spec.
GoogleSignInButton.tsx: on web the pre-mount useEffect consumes the session_id from window.location hash/search and calls api.googleSession; a consumed-set guards against replay. Robust.
FacebookSignInButton.tsx: pure stub, no side-effects, has testID='facebook-signin'.
MapLegend.tsx: 8 property-type rows + Verified badge + Hot listing badge — matches spec.
MapDockedCard.tsx: testIDs docked-save-<id>, docked-view-<id>, docked-contact-<id> all present; contact is emerald outline and only renders when onContact prop supplied — matches spec.
Server.py line 1998-2000 correctly registers google_auth router. No regression on /api/auth/login response shape (access_token + user).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (of what is testable on web preview)

context_for_next_testing_agent: For docked card quick-actions (docked-save-<id>/docked-view-<id>/docked-contact-<id>), you MUST test on native Expo Go build — the web preview renders a static Africa image and does not surface marker onPress → docked card. All social-sign-in + legend + filter chip + backend Google session paths are already covered by /app/backend/tests/test_google_auth_and_map.py (11/11 green).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Both mentioned unresolved items (Facebook alert not captured on web + docked-card quick-actions not reachable via static-image web map) are known web-preview limitations, not regressions.
